description: WHAT: Alias of get_discovery(which=llms-mcp-server) — machine/catalog text for the maps MCP server. Optional offset/limit. USE when an agent needs the server-side llms MCP catalog. NEXT: get_llms_mcp_web, get_links.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return after offset. Omit or null = if remaining payload ≤~30KB return all remaining lines; if larger, return first ~30KB window + nextOffset (O9). Explicit limit keeps 1..10000 line window (MCP caps unchanged — not forced to 30KB). Meta also as trailing # MCP-META lines in summary.

offset.description: 0-based index into a list or discovery file lines (split on \n). 0 = first. Omit = 0. Combine with limit to page. Use nextOffset / offset+limit from a previous result when present.

name: get_llms_mcp_server
title: Get Llms Mcp Server
